title: Germany - 2026.08.05
notes: Germany's governing coalition under Friedrich Merz is struggling to push through a sweeping reform package amid persistent internal divisions between the CDU and SPD over taxes, pensions, and welfare spending. Meanwhile, the broader economy shows tentative signs of stabilisation, with modest second-quarter growth and improved business confidence in July, though analysts warn structural weaknesses remain unresolved. The tension between political gridlock and economic necessity is fast becoming the defining challenge of the Merz government.
